Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

Subs and their routes, supplies, parts, retainers, Free Companies, inventories, income, the market and trends, all in the game. Keep your fleet on this PC with nothing else to install, or share it between PCs (and with the free Windows app) through a database. Type /xivfleet to start.

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
### New
- Settings → Connections in use (shared database): how many of the database's connection slots are taken (when they run out, the plugins can't sync), split into the app, the plugins and anything else, and from which PC. A warning from 80% of the slots. Connections from another login (pgAdmin signed in as postgres, say) are counted, without their PC.
- Settings → Sub Calculator Data: which copy of the Sub Calculator's data is in use (the one this version came with, or a newer one downloaded by the daily check), when it was last checked, and Check now.

### Changed
- A quiet note when live prices fall back: Income's loot and ventures and the Summary's ventures now say in grey when live prices didn't arrive this time (vendor prices shown) or some are from an earlier check; the reason is on hover. The other pages with live prices already said so.
